desc:
Get ready for an exhilarating escape from the most unexpected place – a daycare! This time, it's Suzie's shift, and let's just say she's not the sharpest crayon in the box. This gives you a golden opportunity to slip away unnoticed.

Navigate through 20 thrilling obby stages filled with puzzles, sneaky hideouts, and tricky distractions designed to test your wit and agility. Make your grand escape in "Suzie's Daycare  Escape!"

Once you've mastered the obby basics in Easy mode, challenge yourself with the EXTREME MODE. Here, you'll encounter even trickier challenges and clever traps that will demand your best strategizing skills.

Don't forget to race against the clock and your friends to secure your spot as the top escapee on the Leaderboards.

Suzie's Daycare Escape! (First Person Obby!) - Created by SapphireStudios.

Dive into this captivating adventure where cunning and speed are your best allies. Can you outsmart Suzie and make your daring escape?
